**JuliaActuary** is an ecosystem of packages that makes Julia the easiest language to get started for actuarial workflows.

**Julia** is [an ideal language for Actuaries](/posts/julia-for-actuaries/) and other financial professionals.


It is free, open-source software and you can [join the development on Github](https://github.com/JuliaActuary/).


## Code Examples

::: {.panel-tabset .code-examples}

### Mortality tables

```julia-repl
julia> using MortalityTables

julia> MortalityTables.table("2015 VBT Smoker Distinct Male Non-Smoker ALB")
MortalityTable (Insured Lives Mortality):
   Name:
       2015 VBT Smoker Distinct Male Non-Smoker ALB
   Fields:
       (:select, :ultimate, :metadata)
   Provider:
       American Academy of Actuaries along with the Society of Actuaries
   mort.SOA.org ID:
       3269
   mort.SOA.org link:
       https://mort.soa.org/ViewTable.aspx?&TableIdentity=3269
   Description:
       2015 Valuation Basic Table (VBT) Smoker Distinct Table...
```

### Yield curves

```julia
using FinanceModels

maturities = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0]
rates = [5.0, 5.8, 6.4, 6.8] ./ 100
quotes = ZCBYield.(rates, maturities)

curve = fit(Spline.Linear(), quotes, Fit.Bootstrap())
discount(curve, 2.0)          # discount factor to year 2
zero(curve, 1.5)              # continuously compounded zero rate
forward(curve, 1.0, 2.0)      # rate between years 1 and 2
```

### Financial maths

```julia-repl
julia> using ActuaryUtilities

julia> cashflows = [5, 5, 105]
julia> discount_rate = 0.03

julia> round(present_value(discount_rate, cashflows); digits=2)
105.66

julia> round(duration(Macaulay(), discount_rate, cashflows); digits=2)
2.86

julia> round(duration(discount_rate, cashflows); digits=2)
2.78

julia> round(convexity(discount_rate, cashflows); digits=2)
10.63
```

### Life contingencies

```julia
using LifeContingencies
using MortalityTables
using FinanceCore

# load mortality rates from MortalityTables.jl
vbt2015 = MortalityTables.table("2015 VBT Smoker Distinct Male Non-Smoker ALB")

issue_age = 30
life = SingleLife(                       # The life underlying the risk
    mortality = vbt2015.select[issue_age],    # -- Mortality rates
)

yield = Periodic(0.05, 1)            # Using a flat 5% interest rate

lc = LifeContingency(life, yield)        # combine the life with the yield
ins = Insurance(lc)                      # alternate way to construct: Insurance(life, yield)

# Summary Scalars
present_value(ins)                       # The actuarial present value
premium_net(lc)                          # Net whole life premium
LifeContingencies.V(lc,5)                # Net premium reserve for whole life insurance at time 5
```

:::

The life-contingency example uses the compatible LifeContingencies 2.5 / FinanceCore 2 / MortalityTables 2 environment. See [package compatibility](packages.qmd#current-releases) before combining it with the newer finance and mortality releases.

## Packages

See the [current releases and migration guides](/packages.qmd#current-releases), including the Julia 1.10 minimum for the latest finance and mortality packages.

[`MortalityTables.jl`](/packages.html#mortalitytables.jl)
  - Easily work with standard [mort.SOA.org](https://mort.soa.org/) tables and parametric models with common survival calculations.

[`LifeContingencies.jl`](/packages.html#lifecontingencies.jl)
- Insurance, annuity, premium, and reserve maths.

[`ActuaryUtilities.jl`](/packages.html#actuaryutilities.jl)
- Robust and fast calculations for `internal_rate_of_return`, `duration`, `convexity`, `present_value`, `breakeven`, and AD-based key rate `sensitivities`.

[`FinanceModels.jl`](/packages.html#financemodels.jl)
- Composable contracts, models, and functions for financial instruments — including stochastic short-rate models and Monte Carlo simulation.

[`ExperienceAnalysis.jl`](/packages.html#experienceanalysis.jl)
- Meeting your exposure calculation needs.

[`EconomicScenarioGenerators.jl`](/packages.html#economicscenariogenerators.jl)
- Scenario generation for existing ESG workflows. For current short-rate models, see FinanceModels 7 and the [compatibility notes](/packages.qmd#economicscenariogenerators.jl).
